name: Neon night cities
description: Rain-wet cyberpunk streets, towers and film-still sci-fi at night, plus flat synthwave sunsets and grids.
light: neon magenta and cyan signs, wet reflections, haze
a low orange synthwave sun disc over the horizon, magenta sky
blue pre-dawn light, signs fading, one warm window still lit
dense fog lit from within by coloured signs
composition: street-level one-point perspective, one small figure or car, deep haze in the distance
skyline band across the frame seen from water or a rooftop
looking up between towers, strong verticals, a train or hovercar crossing
from inside, through a rain-streaked window onto the street below
camera_or_medium: cinematic film still, or flat vector synthwave illustration
texture_detail: rain, mist, subtle light bloom, film grain in stills
subjects: an empty rain-wet alley with neon signs
a hovercar crossing between megatowers in fog
a lone figure on a rooftop over a neon skyline
a synthwave sun over a purple grid horizon
